title: Taking on the Scorpenek Droid!
description: As Boba Fett makes his last stand with his assembled allies, they put up a good fight against the Pyke Syndicate's goons. When the Pykes realize they are temporarily outmatched by Boba Fett's cadre, they call in bigger guns — in this case the massive, shielded Scorpenek Droids. With shields that repelled all of their weapons, Boba Fett must resort to desperate measures to survive, let alone defeat the mechanized monsters. Boba Fett takes to the perches above the streets of Mos Espa in a vain effort to take down the walking tanks.
